crossRefs.note: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.
“Enter in by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many are those…
How narrow is the gate, and restricted is the way that leads to life! Few are those who find it.
“Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.
What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is…
For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of…
But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

translations.web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
translations.bsb: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way of death.
translations.kjv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
translations.asv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man; But the end thereof are the ways of death.
